title: Order-invariant queries
exact_target: The seven questions concern whether order-invariant first-order logic collapses on bounded-tree-width graphs, lies in monadic second-order logic, has a zero-one law or locality, and admits effective syntax, together with locality and word-language expressiveness for addition-invariant logic.
